findings.body: `runpy` is imported but never used — the script uses `compile`/`exec` directly rather than `runpy.run_path`. The `globals_dict` assignment exists only to suppress the unused-import lint on `runpy`, but there is no reason to keep `runpy` imported in the first place. Both `import runpy` (line 27) and this assignment should be removed entirely.
findings.existing_code: globals_dict = runpy.run_path.__globals__  # noqa: F841 - keep runpy imported
findings.title: Remove dead runpy import and unused globals_dict assignment

value.summary: The shim safely patches MongoDB's entrypoint by replacing the `enforce_kernel_compatibility` function header with a no-op return and re-attaching the original body to a renamed unused function, then exec'ing the patched source. The approach is sound, but it carries a dead `runpy` import and a no-op `globals_dict` assignment that serve no purpose.
